ops.old: Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into a ball, coated in chopped walnuts, served with crackers. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely sliced spring onions, 1 tsp Worcestershire and a pinch of cayenne until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 2 hours until firm. Roll in 80g finely chopped toasted walnuts mixed with chopped parsley. Sit on a board and serve with 200g crackers and celery sticks.
ops.new: Prawns and baby bok choy stir-fried hot with garlic, ginger and oyster sauce, served over rice. Cook 300g jasmine rice. Peel and devein 500g green prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 1 tsp cornflour. Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok until smoking and fry the prawns for 2 minutes until just pink, then lift out. Add 3 sliced garlic cloves and a thumb of ginger cut into matchsticks and fry for 30 seconds. Add 4 halved baby bok choy and a splash of water and toss for 2 minutes. Return the prawns with 2 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy sauce, toss and serve over the rice.
